6 Requirements Tracing
The following tables reference the requirements specified in [4, SRS BSW General]
and [5, SRS Flex Ray] and links to the fulfillment of these. Please note that if column
“Satisfied by” is empty for a specific requirement this means that this requirement is
not fulfilled by this document.

Description
Satisfied by

pre-processor check of the versions
of all imported include files

able to initialize variables and

function
[SWS_FrIf_05003]

provide a hardware abstraction layer
[SWS_FrIf_05107]

qualities, driver demands
[SWS_FrIf_05089]

Optional functionality of a Basic-SW
component that is not required in the
ECU shall be configurable at

[SWS_FrIf_05089]
